p0-w5.question: Between which potentials vs Li+/Li are boehmite (gamma-AlOOH), corundum and CaCO3 at equilibrium against lithiation (Li-open grand potential) and against oxidation that releases O2 (and CO2 or H2O) with the cation taken up by the anion of each registered electrolyte salt; which route governs each limit (cp3 decision 3); and where is a limit undetermined, and why? (thermodynamic windows; no kinetic statement)
p0-w5.scope: Thermodynamic proxies only: a stability domain, a decomposition energy or a window says which state is at equilibrium, never how fast anything corrodes, dissolves or decomposes.
